notes: If your project has been through SME review, regenerate any reports and export your redirect map again. A client's Final KKE was not always respected: pages they chose to keep could still be treated as consolidated and given a redirect, and several reports counted your recommendation instead of their decision. The Redirect Map Report now uses exactly the rules the redirect CSV does. New: a Build Status report, SME → Review Consolidations, a Site order sort, audiences on sitemap nodes, and a left-aligned sitemap layout.
